dog.description_text:
Milan is a tripod German Shepherd who is as sweet as they come. She recently had one of her legs amputated and is almost completely healed, but that hasn't stopped her from soaking up all the love she can get. She's incredibly affectionate and especially loves sticking her head right into your lap for some extra attention.

Milan is making the trip to New York on September 12 and is currently available for foster-to-adopt. Registered adopters interested in Maple can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, you can do it at hbrdogs.com
